# **1\. Introduction**

## **1.1 Purpose**

This Software Requirements Specification (SRS) document outlines the requirements for developing "Travel Buddy" — a comprehensive travel itinerary planner web application. The primary goal of this application is to enable users to plan, organize, and manage trips end-to-end, covering day-by-day itinerary building, budget tracking, accommodation and transport management, packing checklists, weather forecasts, interactive maps, and travel memory galleries.

## **1.2 Scope**

The scope of this project includes the design, development, testing, and deployment of a travel planning web application catering to:

•       Travelers who can create and manage trips, plan daily activities, track expenses, upload documents, and capture travel memories.

•       Guest users who can explore the application before registering.

 

This SRS covers the functional and non-functional requirements for all 20 planned features of the project, the constraints, assumptions, and high-level system description.

## **1.3 Definitions, Acronyms, and Abbreviations**

•       SRS: Software Requirements Specification

•       FR: Functional Requirement

•       NFR: Non-Functional Requirement

•       UI: User Interface

•       API: Application Programming Interface

•       MERN: MongoDB, Express.js, React.js, Node.js

•       PDF: Portable Document Format

•       OTP: One-Time Password

## **1.4 References**

•       MERN Stack Documentation: MongoDB, Express.js, React.js, Node.js

•       OpenWeatherMap API Documentation

•       Google Maps / Leaflet.js Map API Documentation

•       ExchangeRate-API / Open Exchange Rates Documentation

## **1.5 Overview**

Section 2 provides an overall description of the product, including its user classes and operating environment. Section 3 details the functional and non-functional requirements organized by feature. The document covers all 20 features planned for "Travel Buddy".

 

# **2\. Overall Description**

## **2.1 Product Perspective**

Travel Buddy is a standalone web application built on the MERN stack. It integrates with external APIs where necessary, including weather forecast services, map providers, and currency exchange rate APIs. The application provides an all-in-one solution so that users do not need multiple tools to plan a single trip.

## **2.2 Product Features**

The application includes the following 20 features:

1\.    Create new trip with destination and dates

2\.    Edit trip details (name, dates, description)

3\.    Daily itinerary builder (day-by-day planning)

4\.    Add activities with time, location, and description

5\.    Activity categorization (sightseeing, dining, adventure)

6\.    Budget planning per trip

7\.    Expense tracking by category (food, transport, accommodation)

8\.    Accommodation details management

9\.    Transportation planning (flights, trains, car rentals)

10\.  Trip timeline/schedule view

11\.  Packing checklist builder

12\.  Trip notes & journal entries

13\.  Weather forecast integration per destination

14\.  Map view of all activity locations

15\.  Trip sharing / export to PDF

16\.  Favorite/bookmark trips

17\.  Trip duplication (clone a past itinerary)

18\.  Currency converter for budget planning

19\.  Travel documents vault (passport, visa, tickets)

20\.  Trip completion & memory gallery (photo log)

## **2.3 User Classes and Characteristics**

•       Travelers: Individuals planning personal or group trips. They require an intuitive and organized interface to manage destinations, activities, documents, and expenses.

•       Guests: Unauthenticated users who can browse the application but must register to create and save trips.

•       Administrators: System overseers responsible for monitoring usage, managing user accounts, and maintaining the application.

## **2.4 Operating Environment**

•       Web Application: Accessible on modern web browsers (Chrome, Firefox, Edge, Safari).

•       Mobile Compatibility: Responsive design for smartphones and tablets.

•       Server-Side: Node.js and Express.js running in a cloud environment.

•       Database: MongoDB for storing trip data, user accounts, documents, and media.

•       Hosting: Deployment on a cloud platform such as Vercel, Render, or equivalent.

## **2.5 Constraints**

•       Security: User data, travel documents, and photos must be stored securely with access restricted to authenticated owners.

•       Performance: The system must handle real-time data fetches (weather, maps, currency) with minimal latency.

•       External API Dependency: Weather, map, and currency features depend on third-party API availability and rate limits.

•       Time & Resource: The project is to be delivered within the academic semester by a team of four developers.

## **2.6 Assumptions and Dependencies**

•       Users have a stable internet connection for real-time features such as weather and maps.

•       Third-party services for weather, maps, and currency exchange are available and reliable.

•       Users will grant location access where needed for map features.

•       External APIs used will be free-tier or have sufficient quota for development and demonstration purposes.

 

# **3\. System Requirements**

## **3.1 Functional Requirements**

**3.1.1 Create New Trip**

**FR-1 Create Trip:** The system shall allow authenticated users to create a new trip.

**FR-2 Destination Entry:** The system will allow users shall be able to enter a destination for their trip

**FR-3 Date Selection:** The system will allow users shall be able to select start and end dates for the trip

**FR-4 Save Trip:** The system shall save trip information persistently to the database.

**FR-5 Trip Name:**The system will allow users to create a trip name.

**3.1.2 Edit Trip Details**

**FR-6 Edit Name:** The system will allow users to edit the trip name.

**FR-7 Edit Dates:** The system will allow users to be able to update the trip start and end dates.

**FR-8 Edit Description:** The system will allow users to be able to add or update a trip description.

**FR-9 Save Updates:** The system will allow users to save updated trip details to the system.

**FR \-10 Trip description:**  The system will allow users to add, edit trip descriptions.

 

**3.1.3 Daily Itinerary Builder**

**FR-11 Day-by-Day View:** The system shall allow users to create a day-by-day itinerary for the trip duration.

**FR-12 View All Days:** The system will allow users to view all days within the trip duration.

**FR-13 Add Day Plans:** The system will allow users to add plans for each day of the trip.

**FR-14 Modify Plans:** The system will allow users to modify existing daily plans.

**FR-15 Delete Plans:** The system will allow users to be able to delete daily plans.

 

**3.1.4 Add Activities**

**FR-15 Add Activity:** The system shall allow users to add activities to a specific day in the itinerary.

**FR-16 Activity Details:** The system shall allow that each activity shall include activity time, location, and description.

**FR-17 Edit Activity:** The system will allow users to edit existing activities.

**FR-18 Delete Activity:** The system will allow users to be able to delete activities from the itinerary.

 

**3.1.5 Activity Categorization**

### **FR-19 Assign Category:** The system shall allow users to assign a category to each activity during creation or editing from predefined options: (Sightseeing, Dining, Adventure, Shopping, Entertainment,Relaxation,Transport)

### **FR-20 Display Category:** The system shall display the assigned category for each activity in the itinerary view using visual indicators (e.g., labels, colors, or icons).

### **FR-21 Filter by Category:** The system shall allow users to filter activities within a day based on selected categories.

### **FR-22 Group by Category:** The system shall allow users to view activities grouped by category within a day.

 

**3.1.6 Budget Planning Per Trip**

**FR-23 Set Budget:** Users shall be able to set a total budget amount for each trip with a specified currency.

**FR-24 Budget Breakdown:** Users shall be able to allocate budget amounts to sub-categories such as food, accommodation, transport, and activities.

**FR-25 Budget Overview:** The system shall display the total budget, amount spent, and remaining balance for each trip.

**FR-26 Edit & Reset Budget:** Users shall be able to modify or reset the budget at any point during trip planning.

 

**3.1.7 Expense Tracking by Category**

**FR-27 Add Expense:** Users shall be able to log an expense with amount, date, category, and optional description.

**FR-28 Category Assignment:** Each expense shall be assigned to a category: Food, Transport, Accommodation, or Other.

**FR-29 Expense List:** The system shall display a chronological list of all logged expenses for a trip.

**FR-30 Edit/Delete Expense:** Users shall be able to edit or delete any previously logged expense entry.

**FR-31 Category Summary:** The system shall show a per-category total and percentage of total spend.

 

**3.1.8 Accommodation Details Management**

**FR-32 Add Accommodation:** Users shall be able to add accommodation entries with name, address, check-in/check-out dates, and cost.

**FR-33 Confirmation Storage:** Users shall be able to store booking confirmation numbers and attach documents or images.

**FR-34  Multi-Accommodation:** Users shall be able to manage multiple accommodations within a single trip itinerary.

**FR-35 Edit/Delete:** Users shall be able to update or remove any accommodation record at any time.

 

**3.1.9 Transportation Planning**

**FR-36 Add Transport:** Users shall be able to add transport entries specifying type (flight, train, car rental), provider, and departure/arrival time and location.

**FR-37 Reference Numbers:** Users shall be able to store booking reference numbers and e-ticket attachments per transport entry.

**FR-38 Multi-Leg Journeys:** Users shall be able to chain multiple transport segments to represent a multi-leg journey.

**FR-39 Transport Timeline:** The system shall display all transport segments in chronological order within the trip timeline.

 

**3.1.10 Trip Timeline / Schedule View**

**FR-40 Timeline Display:** The system shall display the trip itinerary in a timeline or chronological schedule format.

**FR-41 Activity Detail View:** Users shall be able to view activity details such as description, location, and duration.

**FR-42 Mark Completion:** Users shall be able to mark activities as completed or pending.

**FR-43 Overlap Detection:** The system shall notify users if two activities overlap in time.

**FR-44 Reorder Activities:** Users shall be able to reorder activities by changing time slots.

 

**3.1.11 Packing Checklist Builder**

**FR-45 Create Checklist:** Users shall be able to create a packing checklist associated with a specific trip.

**FR-46 Add/Edit/Delete Items:** Users shall be able to add, edit, and delete checklist items.

**FR-47 Mark Items:** Users shall be able to mark items as packed or unpacked.

**FR-48 Categorize Items:** Users shall be able to categorize items such as clothes, electronics, documents, and toiletries.

**FR-49 Progress Display:** The system shall show packing progress as a count and percentage of packed items out of total items.

 ![][image1]![][image2]![][image3]

**3.1.12 Trip Notes & Journal Entries**

**FR-50 Write Notes:** Users shall be able to write notes or journal entries related to a trip.

**FR-51 Edit/Delete Notes:** Users shall be able to edit and delete existing journal entries.

**FR-52 Attach to Days:** Users shall be able to attach notes to specific days or activities of the trip.

**FR-53 Auto-Save Date:** The system shall save notes automatically with the current date and time.

**FR-54 Search/Filter Notes:** Users shall be able to search or filter journal entries by date.

 ![][image4]![][image5]

**3.1.13 Weather Forecast Integration**

**FR-55 Show Forecast:** The system shall display the weather forecast for the selected trip destination.

**FR-56 Trip Date Forecast:** The system shall display weather information relevant to the trip dates.

**FR-57 Trip Page Access:** Users shall be able to view the weather forecast directly from the trip page.

 

**3.1.14 Map View of Activity Locations**

**FR-58 Activity Map:** The system shall display all activity locations on an interactive map.

**FR-59 Activity Details on Map:** Users shall be able to click on a map location to view the activity details.

**FR-60 Auto-Update Map:** The map shall update automatically when new activities are added or removed.

 

**3.1.15 Trip Sharing / Export to PDF**

**FR-61 Export PDF:** Users shall be able to export their trip itinerary as a PDF file.

**FR-62 Download PDF:** Users shall be able to download the generated PDF of their trip plan.

**FR-63 PDF Content:** The exported PDF shall include trip details, daily schedule, and activities.

**FR-64 Social Sharing:** Users shall be able to share the PDF via social media or a shareable link.

 

**3.1.16 Favorite / Bookmark Trips**

**FR-65 Mark Favorite:** Users shall be able to mark trips as favorite or bookmarked.

**FR-66 View Favorites:** Users shall be able to view a list of all their bookmarked trips.

**FR-67 Remove Favorite:** Users shall be able to remove trips from their favorites list.

**FR-68 Visual Indicator:** The system shall visually indicate whether a trip is currently favorited.![][image6]![][image7]![][image8]

 

**3.1.17 Trip Duplication (Clone a Past Itinerary)**

**FR-69 Clone Trip:** Users shall be able to duplicate an existing trip itinerary.

**FR-70 Copy Details:** The system shall copy trip details such as destination, activities, notes, and schedule into the new trip.

**FR-71 Unique ID:** The system shall assign a new unique trip ID to the duplicated itinerary.

**FR-72 Rename Clone:** Users shall be able to rename the duplicated trip.

**FR-73 Update Dates:** Users shall be able to update dates in the duplicated trip.

 

**3.1.18 Currency Converter for Budget Planning**

**FR-74 Currency Selection:** Users shall be able to select a base currency and a target currency from a list of supported international currencies.

**FR-75 Real-Time Conversion:** The system shall convert entered amounts using current or cached exchange rates and display the result instantly.

**FR-76 Multi-Currency Display:** Users shall be able to view their trip budget and expenses converted into their home currency at any time.

**FR-77 Offline Fallback:** When internet is unavailable, the system shall use the last cached exchange rates and notify the user of the data age.

 

**3.1.19 Travel Documents Vault**

**FR-78 Upload Documents:** Users shall be able to upload travel documents such as passport, visa, or tickets.

**FR-79 View/Download:** Users shall be able to view or download their uploaded documents.

**FR-80 Delete Documents:** Users shall be able to delete uploaded documents when no longer needed.

 

**3.1.20 Trip Completion & Memory Gallery**

**FR-81 Mark Completed:** Users shall be able to mark a trip as completed after finishing the trip.

**FR-82 Upload Photos:** Users shall be able to upload photos related to a completed trip.

**FR-83 Gallery View:** The system shall display uploaded photos in a gallery view for the trip.

 

## **3.2 Non-Functional Requirements**

**3.2.1 Create New Trip**

**NFR-1 Performance:** The system shall create and save a new trip within 2 seconds.

**NFR-2 Usability:** The trip creation interface shall allow users to complete the process in 3 steps or fewer.

**NFR-3 Validation:** The system shall validate that the end date is not earlier than the start date.

**NFR-4 Data Integrity:** Trip data shall not be lost during submission.

**NFR-5 Security:** Only authenticated users shall be allowed to create trips.

 

**3.2.2 Edit Trip Details**

**NFR-6 Performance:** Updates to trip details shall be saved within 2 seconds.

**NFR-7 Consistency:** The system shall maintain consistent trip data after edits.

**NFR-8 Usability:** The edit interface shall allow users to modify fields without navigating multiple pages.

**NFR-9 Security:** Only the trip owner shall be permitted to edit the trip details.

 

**3.2.3 Daily Itinerary Builder**

**NFR-10 Performance:** The system shall display the itinerary for a trip within 2 seconds.

**NFR-11 Scalability:** The system shall support itineraries for trips up to 30 days without performance degradation.

**NFR-12 Data Safety:** All itinerary changes shall be automatically saved or confirmed before leaving the page.

**NFR-13 Usability:** Users shall be able to easily navigate between days in the itinerary.

 

**3.2.4 Add Activities**

**NFR-14 Performance:** Adding or updating an activity shall take less than 1 second to reflect in the UI.

**NFR-15 Validation:** The system shall ensure valid time format and that all required activity fields are filled.

**NFR-16 Usability:** Activity creation shall require minimal input fields and be easy to complete.

**NFR-17 Data Integrity:** Activity data shall be stored without duplication or loss.

 

**3.2.5 Activity Categorization**

**NFR-18 Performance:** Activities shall be categorized and filtered instantly when a category is selected.

**NFR-19 Consistency:** Categories shall follow predefined labels to avoid inconsistency across trips.

**NFR-20 Usability:** Users shall select categories through a simple dropdown or selection menu.

**NFR-21 Maintainability:** New categories shall be addable without requiring major system changes.

 

**3.2.6 Budget Planning Per Trip**

**NFR-22 Accuracy:** Budget calculations and totals must be accurate to two decimal places at all times.

**NFR-23 Usability:** Budget entry forms shall be intuitive and completable by a new user in under 2 minutes.

**NFR-24 Persistence:** Budget data shall be saved automatically and retained across sessions without data loss.

**NFR-25 Performance:** Budget summary updates shall reflect changes within 1 second of user input.

 

**3.2.7 Expense Tracking by Category**

**NFR-26 Performance:** The expense list shall load within 2 seconds even when 500+ entries exist for a single trip.

**NFR-27 Data Integrity:** Expense entries shall not be lost or duplicated during concurrent edits or connectivity issues.

**NFR-28 Accessibility:** Expense input fields shall support keyboard navigation and screen-reader compatibility.

**NFR-29 Scalability:** The system shall support tracking of up to 10,000 expense entries per user without degradation.

 

**3.2.8 Accommodation Details Management**

**NFR-30 Security:** Uploaded confirmation documents shall be stored securely with access restricted to the trip owner.

**NFR-31 Reliability:** Accommodation records shall be retrievable with 99.9% uptime during the planning phase.

**NFR-32 Validation:** The accommodation form shall validate date conflicts and warn users of overlapping stays.

**NFR-33 Storage:** The system shall support file uploads up to 10 MB per attachment for booking confirmations.

 

**3.2.9 Transportation Planning**

**NFR-34 Performance:** Transport entries shall be saved and visible in the timeline within 1 second of submission.

**NFR-35 Compatibility:** The transport planner shall function correctly on modern browsers including Chrome, Firefox, Safari, and Edge.

**NFR-36 Validation:** The system shall validate that departure time is before arrival time and flag conflicting segments.

**NFR-37 Maintainability:** Transport type options shall be configurable by developers without requiring front-end code changes.

 

**3.2.10 Trip Timeline / Schedule View**

**NFR-38 Performance:** The timeline view shall load within 2-3 seconds under normal usage.

**NFR-39 Usability:** The interface shall be easy to read and visually organized with clear date and time formatting.

**NFR-40 Responsiveness:** The timeline shall support responsive design for different screen sizes.

**NFR-41 Data Security:** Timeline data shall be stored securely and consistently.

 

**3.2.11 Packing Checklist Builder**

**NFR-42 Performance:** The checklist feature shall respond quickly to add, edit, and check actions without noticeable delay.

**NFR-43 Persistence:** The checklist shall remain available after logout and login, tied to the user account.

**NFR-44 Accuracy:** The system shall maintain accuracy in item status and packed/unpacked counts.

**NFR-45 Security:** Access to checklist data shall be restricted to the authenticated owner.

**NFR-46 Responsiveness:** The checklist shall be readable on both small and large screens.

 

**3.2.12 Trip Notes & Journal Entries**

**NFR-47 Performance:** Notes shall save quickly without noticeable delay.

**NFR-48 Usability:** The text entry area shall be user-friendly and readable.

**NFR-49 Responsiveness:** The notes feature shall work on web and mobile-friendly layouts.

**NFR-50 Security:** User notes shall be stored securely and accessible only to the authenticated owner.

**NFR-51 Data Safety:** The system shall prevent accidental data loss during writing through auto-save functionality.

 

**3.2.13 Weather Forecast Integration**

**NFR-52 Performance:** Weather data shall load within a few seconds of a page request.

**NFR-53 Usability:** The weather information shall be easy to read and clearly formatted.

**NFR-54 Reliability:** The system shall retrieve weather data from a reliable third-party weather service API.

 

**3.2.14 Map View of Activity Locations**

**NFR-55 Performance:** The map shall load quickly and render all activity markers without significant delay.

**NFR-56 Usability:** The map shall allow users to zoom and pan easily.

**NFR-57 Compatibility:** The map shall function correctly across different devices and screen sizes.

 

**3.2.15 Trip Sharing / Export to PDF**

**NFR-58 Performance:** The PDF shall be generated and ready for download within a few seconds.

**NFR-59 Quality:** The exported PDF shall be clearly formatted and well-organized.

**NFR-60 File Size:** The exported PDF file size shall be reasonable for downloading and sharing.

 

**3.2.16 Favorite / Bookmark Trips**

**NFR-61 Performance:** The favorite/unfavorite action shall complete instantly or near-instantly.

**NFR-62 Persistence:** Favorite data shall persist across sessions and devices.

**NFR-63 Security:** Only authorized users shall be able to view and manage their own favorites.

**NFR-64 Reliability:** The feature shall be reliable and not lose saved favorites.

 

**3.2.17 Trip Duplication**

**NFR-65 Performance:** The duplication process shall complete within a few seconds.

**NFR-66 Reliability:** The cloning feature shall produce accurate and complete copies of all trip data.

**NFR-67 Data Integrity:** The system shall prevent data corruption during duplication.

**NFR-68 Security:** The system shall prevent duplication of trips the user does not own or cannot access.

**NFR-69 Fault Tolerance:** The system shall recover gracefully if duplication fails, notifying the user appropriately.

 

**3.2.18 Currency Converter**

**NFR-70 Accuracy:** Exchange rates shall be refreshed at least every 24 hours from a reliable financial data source.

**NFR-71 Performance:** Currency conversion calculations shall complete and display results within 500 milliseconds.

**NFR-72 Availability:** The converter shall support a minimum of 50 international currencies including USD, EUR, GBP, JPY, and BDT.

**NFR-73 Security:** API keys used to fetch exchange rates shall be stored server-side and never exposed to the client.

 

**3.2.19 Travel Documents Vault**

**NFR-74 Security:** Uploaded travel documents shall be stored securely with access restricted to the authenticated owner.

**NFR-75 Compatibility:** The system shall support common file formats including PDF, JPG, and PNG.

**NFR-76 Performance:** Documents shall open quickly when requested by the user.

 

**3.2.20 Trip Completion & Memory Gallery**

**NFR-77 Performance:** Photos shall upload and load within a few seconds.

**NFR-78 Usability:** The gallery shall be easy to view and navigate.

**NFR-79 Compatibility:** The system shall support common image formats such as JPG and PNG.

 

# **4\. Technology Stack & Architectural Overview**

## **4.1 MERN Stack Components**

•       MongoDB: Document-oriented database for storing trip data, user accounts, expenses, documents, and photos.

•       Express.js: Node.js framework for building the RESTful API and handling server-side logic.

•       React.js: Front-end library for building a responsive and interactive user interface.

•       Node.js: JavaScript runtime for executing the back-end application.

## **4.2 External Integrations**

•       Weather API: OpenWeatherMap or equivalent for destination weather forecasts.

•       Map API: Google Maps / Leaflet.js for interactive activity location maps.

•       Currency API: ExchangeRate-API or Open Exchange Rates for real-time currency conversion.

•       PDF Generation: jsPDF or Puppeteer for exporting trip itineraries as PDF files.

•       File Storage: Cloud storage (e.g., Cloudinary or AWS S3) for travel documents and photos.

## **4.3 High-Level Architecture**

•       Presentation Layer (React.js): Handles user interaction, displays itinerary data, maps, weather, and gallery.

•       Business Logic Layer (Express.js / Node.js): Processes requests, enforces business rules, and coordinates API calls.

•       Data Layer (MongoDB): Stores all persistent data including users, trips, activities, expenses, documents, and photos.

 

# **5\. Conclusion**

This SRS provides a comprehensive outline for the design and development of "Travel Buddy" — a full-featured travel itinerary planner web application built on the MERN stack. It covers all 20 planned features with detailed functional and non-functional requirements to guide the development team. The application aims to deliver a user-friendly, secure, and scalable solution that empowers travelers to plan, manage, and remember their journeys entirely within a single platform.
